title: S7 Review Plan
description: The single authority for one S7 review round: frozen baseline, the exact required Claim set, and the Assignment DAG projection (L3-S7 §3.2-§3.4). Registered via `loop-harness runtime review-plan`; the runtime pins path+sha256 and derives Claim dispositions from consumed ReviewResults.

frozen_subjects.description: Exact fingerprinted product/config/test/spec surfaces this round binds. Every ReviewResult must bind the digest computed over this set.

coverage_inventory.description: Frozen S6 changed-surface denominator. Every current-generation completion scope must appear here and in at least one Claim source_refs.

e2e_assets.description: Existing CASE/PATH assets and fingerprints required when e2e_coverage_state=regression_available.

source_refs.description: Evidence or surface references consumed by the Planner. On TR-012 re-entry this must include the current change_impact evidence reference; runtime validation then binds its changed_artifacts to frozen_subjects. The schema validates shape only.

claims.description: The single required Claim set. Static/E2E/discovery are computed views over this set, not separate authorities (L3-S7 v0.7.0).

target.description: Exact module, path, contract clause, CASE/PATH, runtime invariant or failure mode.

oracle.description: What observable fact counts as pass/fail.

na_rationale.description: Required when applicability=not_applicable: why this Claim does not apply, with evidence.

na_checklist_id.description: Required when applicability=not_applicable: the N/A checklist (or impact-analysis artifact id) the conclusion was checked against. A bare rationale with no checklist is not a verifiable N/A (S7-9/RC-07).

source_refs.description: REQ, risk, impact, BUG history, Closing Contract or CASE/PATH sources. N/A decisions need sources too.

focus_key.description: Round-local professional focus used for Assignment grouping; no global registry or minimum count.

assignments.description: Claim responsibility grouping and DAG projection. One Assignment may cover several same-lens Claims; the exact-set coverage rules are enforced by the plan validator.

non_overlap_boundary.description: What this Assignment owns and what adjacent Reviewers must not redo.

execution_wave.description: static = DV/QA white-box Claims (Wave A); behavior = E2E and specialty Claims that unlock only after every required static Claim has a disposition (L3-S7 §5).

verification_artifact_workspace.description: Only for e2e cold_start: the isolated write surface for new E2E spec/fixture/evidence. Writes outside this surface during verification are hard-denied.

dispatch_capacity_policy.description: Fixed by L3-S7 §4.5: required Assignments may queue but never be deleted or merged to fit platform capacity. Switching to bounded_flow is a quality-policy downgrade that requires a human decision.

coverage_justification.description: Required when a whole lens (delivery/qa) has zero required claims: proof the round contains no executable or maintainability impact (pure docs/metadata change).
